what.text: Displaced people from Serbia and Kosovo live internally as well as in host countries including France, Germany, Switzerland, the United States, and Italy.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR recorded 209453 people forced from their homes by conflict who were living inside Serbia and Kosovo whom UNHCR protects or assists.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR recorded 18522 refugees from Serbia and Kosovo living in France.

why.text: The provided sources do not detail specific conflict names or active opposition groups to explain the causes of conflict displacement.
The only recorded disaster hazard type associated with displacement inside Serbia and Kosovo in the dataset is Flood.

when.text: In 2014, IDMC recorded 33237 new internal displacements from disasters inside Serbia and Kosovo during that year.
In 2015, the count of asylum seekers from Serbia and Kosovo across all host countries combined reached a year-end total of 53292.
By 2025, the year-end total of asylum seekers across all host countries combined was lower than in 2015.

how.text: The sources do not say what routes people took when moving.
UNHCR internal displacement figures count people displaced inside Serbia and Kosovo by conflict whom UNHCR protects or assists at the end of the year.
Disaster figures from IDMC count the number of new internal displacement movements during each year rather than individual people.
